title: mut.fog_and_light_beam
mutation_directive: Add atmospheric depth: enable THREE.FogExp2 with density 0.025-0.040 matched to scene background color, and add a volumetric light beam by rendering a tall thin Cone mesh with a custom translucent additive shader (vertical, off-center top-left or top-right). Light intensity should be visible but not dominant — particles INTERSECTING the beam should brighten. This is a single, definite, cinematic light source — not generic ambient lighting.
